purpose: Full-quality async cooldown candidate with motion ROI refresh, testing whether local refresh can make candidate_0017-quality color ownership viable.
expected_effect: Reduce full-quality async worker cost by processing only the motion ROI.
Preserve finer color-contour ownership than the coarse candidate_0028 bucket.
Measure whether ROI-local refresh is a viable next direction before adding split-frame refresh.
risk: ROI replacement can leave stale full-quality cached contours outside the changed region.
Broad camera pan can produce a full-frame motion ROI; in that case the area cap rejects ROI refresh and falls back to full-frame async refresh.
If the motion ROI is too large during camera pan, full-quality extraction may still exceed the jitter budget.
